statement: Pinned public host implementations provide distinct direct hidraw/feature-report and kernel-derived evdev consumer paths for Xbox 360. A virtual Xbox 360 UHID node's host driver/SDL backend must be observed rather than assumed from VID/PID or mapping database.

applicability.revision: source revisions pinned in part 1 and G, host versions not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer-routing documentation only: xpad decodes native XUSB on vendor-specific USB interface and has its own FF/LED; virtualgamepad UHID is deliberately standard HID, decoded via HID usages/evdev and not automatically the SDL XUSB decoder. No actual Steam, SDL, browser, Wine, InputPlumber or emulator host test was run. Additional independent source pin: Chromium Gamepad Linux udev input/hidraw enumeration; WebHID has both static and dynamic protection rules. InputPlumber source matching is version-scoped and does not assert a local host pass.
